summary: A natural fermentation product made of 100% Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells grown on sugar cane molasses — a high-value protein source with a balanced amino acid profile and the best natural source of B vitamins.
pitch: Our flagship inactive dried yeast. Spray-dried from molasses-grown Saccharomyces cerevisiae, it acts as a prophylactic micro-ingredient and immune-system booster while adding natural palatability that lifts feed intake and feed conversion.
benefits: Higher survival and growth rate
Increased weight gain
Improves efficiency of the digestive system
Faster digestion and absorption of nutrients
Higher feed consumption with better FCR
Reduces the pathogenic bacterial loads in gut
Enhances immunity and controls stress

aminoAcids.footnote: TAA — Total Amino Acid · DAA — Digestible Amino Acid · NE — Not Evaluated

inclusionAlt: Poultry feed — broilers and layers: 1.0 % – 2.5 % of total feed
Aqua feed — shrimp, eels & fish: 2.5 % – 5.0 % of total feed
Swine — piglets & sows: 2.5 % – 5.0 % of total feed
Bovines — beef & dairy cattle: 250 g / head / day
Pet food — dog & cat: 2.5 % – 5.0 % of total feed
storage: Keep in a cool, dry and aerated place, free of insects and stacked over pallets
shelfLife: 12 months from production date (24 months when stored per the method of analysis sheet)
packing: 25 kg & 40 kg HDPE paper bags with liner

summary: A six-strain consortium of Bacillus, Lactobacillus and Saccharomyces built to colonise the shrimp and fish gut and hold pathogenic load down.
pitch: Six defined strains at a combined 280 × 10³ cfu/g, formulated to survive pellet mill and extruder conditions so the count that leaves our plant is close to the count that reaches the animal.
ingredients: Bacillus licheniformis, Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus acidophilus, Lactobacillus sporogenes, Saccharomyces boulardii, Saccharomyces cerevisiae

Better feed intake

Improves health and immunity of fish and shrimp

0.5 to 1 kg per ton of feed

pitch: Registered under Trade Mark No. 4064646, Nutrimins-DMM is our livestock line. It has been independently assayed by the Animal Feed Analytical and Quality Assurance Laboratory at TANUVAS, Namakkal — including a full mycotoxin panel, all not detected.
